scope: local x86_64 CPU in-process simulation with cpp_native planner; no ROS DDS, no ARM64 board, no vehicle
changes: monochrome + no-video simulation no longer synthesizes unused 15Hz camera frames
video overlay reuses the cached vision result instead of running the stateful pipeline twice
camera polygon fill reuses precomputed pixel grids
cone association/nearest-distance avoids per-track NumPy allocations
segment extraction slices once instead of repeated list.pop(0)

profile_route_a_seed3_no_video.command: python3 -m cProfile -m sim.cli --config-dir <320x240 staging> --route A --seed 3 --scenario demo --no-video --planner-engine native
profile_route_a_seed3_no_video.note: cProfile adds overhead; before/after are from the same host and command. Camera rendering was the dominant cost before the change.

stress_both_routes_seeds_0_5.note: Success count and failed seeds are unchanged; only wall-clock simulation overhead improved.

not_verified: ARM64/Atlas board latency and Ascend NPU execution
real ROS 2 DDS scheduling and gateway timing
